# Rough-In Conduit & Feeder Schedule
Commercial Suite 104 - Riverbend Plaza

## Project Parameters
- Lead Estimator: Jamal Sandoval
- Field Supervisor: Ethan Sato
- Review Date: 03/18/2026
- Electrical Drawings Reference: E-201 Rev 2

## Panel Feeder Specifications
| Panel ID | Location | Bus Rating | Minimum OCPD | Conductor Size & Type | Conduit Trade Size |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Panel LP1 | Utility Room 102 | 100A, 120/208V, 3PH | 100A | 4x #3 AWG Cu THHN | 1-1/4 in EMT |
| Panel HP1 | Elec Closet 106 | 225A, 277/480V, 3PH | 200A | 4x 3/0 AWG Cu THHN | 2 in EMT |
| Panel DP1 | Main Switchgear | 400A, 120/208V, 3PH | 400A | 2x (4x 3/0 AWG Cu THHN) | 2x 2 in EMT |

## Installation & Routing Notes
- Route feeder for Panel LP1 from Main Distribution Switchboard through Corridor 101 to Utility Room 102.
- Field crew must pull 4x 1/0 AWG Cu THHN conductors for the Panel LP1 run to verify proper termination.
- Install pull box at 85 ft mark along Panel HP1 conduit run to maintain pulling tension limits.
- Panel HP1 run requires 48 ft overhead along west wall, 62 ft across main retail ceiling, and 15 ft vertical drop into Elec Closet 106.
- Total raceway length for Panel HP1 run measures 145 ft between enclosures.
- Field verification completed by Alicia Rowland on site prior to coring through masonry wall.

errors.quote: pull 4x 1/0 AWG Cu THHN conductors for the Panel LP1 run
errors.explanation: The Panel Feeder Specifications table explicitly designates Panel LP1 as requiring 4x #3 AWG Cu THHN conductors, not 1/0 AWG.
errors.fix: pull 4x #3 AWG Cu THHN conductors for the Panel LP1 run

errors.quote: raceway length for Panel HP1 run measures 145 ft between enclosures
errors.explanation: The individual segments listed are 48 ft, 62 ft, and 15 ft, which sum to 125 ft, not 145 ft.
errors.fix: raceway length for Panel HP1 run measures 125 ft between enclosures
